Working Interfaces · field manual

Interfaces for accountable work.

A knowledge-first environment for designing applications where information moves through stages, evidence changes assumptions, and decisions stay inspectable. The manual behind this page is the evidence; this page is the way in.

13 manual chapters, each routed through Astro

2 lanes: raw HTML experiments and canonical knowledge

How work moves here

Two lanes, one destination.

Nothing is formalized before it has earned it. Both lanes stay open and neither one blocks the other.

Lane 01 · raw HTML

Experiments stay plain

Studies are written as plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. They are visual evidence, not production architecture, and an experiment may remain evidence forever.

  • No build step, no component API, no test obligation.
  • The original static manual still ships unchanged under /legacy/.
  • Proven parts are migrated selectively; a mass rewrite is not planned.
Open the experiment register →

Lane 02 · canonical knowledge

Records are authored once

A record is one Markdown file with a validated frontmatter contract. It is published to people and machines from that single source.

  • A readable page for review and discussion.
  • A JSON resource for tools and agents.
  • A raw Markdown download for grounding.
Open the knowledge index →

The manual

From visual direction to a working case system.

Each chapter is a standalone interactive document. Astro wraps the established HTML at build time, so the pages keep their original appearance and behavior.

  1. 01 Interface Field Guide Broad contemporary UI direction, reusable patterns, and visual references beyond generic SaaS styling. →
  2. 02 Adoption Lane Decision Instrument Provenance, gates, uncertainty, route logic, and equal No-Go outcomes for the stricter method lane. →
  3. 03 Case Component Atlas The shared shell across project, change, and consulting domains. →
  4. 04 Specialized Components Inputs, money, evidence, people, statistics, and structured states. →
  5. 05 Analytical Components Polished ranges, discrete judgment, intervals, and production-library references. →
  6. 06 Typography + Color Lab Interactive type roles, semantic color, density, contrast, and realistic previews. →
  7. 07 Page Compositions Heroes, portfolio views, workspaces, decision reviews, dossiers, and mobile. →
  8. 08 Interaction + Behavior Save, carry forward, supersede, skip, conclude, reopen, and conflict behavior. →
  9. 09 Object Model How cases, stages, claims, evidence, judgments, decisions, and artifacts connect. →
  10. 10 State Machine Case and stage states with explicit prerequisites and consequences. →
  11. 11 Content + UX Writing Precise interface language and explicit origins for information. →
  12. 12 Accessibility Lab Stress-test grayscale, projection, zoom, mobile, long labels, and reduced motion. →
  13. 13 Motion Language Motion for causality: saving, carrying, superseding, revealing, and route travel. →
  14. REF Complete Reference App One cohesive implementation that switches domain mode without changing the shell grammar. →
